quest.summary: Every day I buy blue-and-white shards. Did a single bowl come out of the collapsed hall whole?

steps.clue: The collapsed hall, south of the ruin gate. A trowel digs there.

offer: Shards, every day. Blue and white, all from one hall. Never a whole one.
The hall that fell in, south of the gate. One dig in twelve, I would guess.
Safe till the lanterns light. After that the ruin is not mine to sell.
waiting: Shards are what that hall gives, mostly. Keep at it.
Safe till the lanterns light. After that the ruin is not mine to sell.
done: Whole. Buyers will walk a day for that. Ha - they will say I dug it.
A reed basket, not one I sell. It picks quicker than mine. Yours now.
